title.fr_fr: Point de passage de drone logistique

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table (x4) : Blue Dye, Redstone Torch, [[gv:circuit_basic|Integrated Circuit Board]].

Used to make :
[[gv:drone_crate_provider|Logistics Provider Crate]], [[gv:drone_crate_requester|Logistics Requester Crate]], [[gv:drone_dock|Logistics Drone Dock]].
